title: THREE LANES
description: The claim in condensed display type, then a six-year record in three lanes, phone, web and server, newest first: real screens sit in the lane they run in, under a red Today line. The care platform, the Bayyinah TV app and the care platform's server fill the first row. Press a lane header and the record answers: the other lanes dim, that lane's bars turn red, and the line under the claim becomes that lane's sentence.
signature: Big Shoulders Display (claim 66px/700, years 44px/800, lane headers and entry names 28px) for the claim, years and lane headers; Libre Franklin 16px text; Martian Mono 13px facts. Warm paper oklch(97% 0.008 50) and ink oklch(21% 0.012 50) with one red, oklch(50% 0.19 25), the calendars' today line: it marks Today, the chosen lane, its bars, focus and link hover. The one moment: choosing a lane (click, tap, arrow keys): the other lanes fade to 22% in 300 ms ease-out, the chosen lane's bars turn red, the lane sentence replaces the second line; keyboard and reduced motion switch instantly; pressing the chosen lane again shows all.
rule: the page is a six-year record in three lanes, phone, web and server; every product sits in the lane it runs in and the year it shipped, and the lane headers are the control: choose one and the whole record answers
designRead: Reading this as: a phone-and-web developer who moved to full stack, for a hiring manager on a phone, leading with the care platform (web, with its server beside it), in a dated record of three lanes the visitor can choose between.
hook: The site where the work sits in three lanes, phone, web and server, and when you press SERVER the whole record dims down to two entries that start in 2026.
lead: The care-management platform, 2023–26, in the web lane of the first row: the largest checkable change (a live platform being rebuilt one screen at a time, with the same test on both apps), with its server beside it in the server lane and the Bayyinah TV app in the phone lane. Offday, the own product, moved to the last 2026 row.
composition: 3 (the claim drawn as a picture: three lanes are the sentence) crossed with 4 (a dated record, years down the page) and 6 (one mechanism the visitor operates: the lane headers, with the four answers readable before any input).

fourAnswers.desktop: who: Gentrit Rashiti (masthead, claim) / what: phone and web apps; 5+ years, two platform rewrites / for whom: care teams, readers and shoppers / proof: the care team calendar (real product screens, invented data), the Bayyinah TV app inside the iPhone, the care platform's server note with 2 requests not 16, the link bayyinahtv.com, the years 2021, 2023, 2026 in the lane headers
fourAnswers.phone: who: Gentrit Rashiti / what: phone and web apps / for whom: care teams, readers and shoppers / proof: the 5+ years line with the bayyinahtv.com link, the three lane headers with their since-years, Today and 2026, the care calendar crop from about y=465

allowed: C17 (declared, not triggered in the final run: LCP 804 ms desktop, 732 ms phone): a below-fold image painted during the checker's scripted scroll on the dev server
T23 (declared, not triggered in the final run): the site's shared Tailwind hover-lift utility, which no element of this draft uses

holdback: Hook 8, not 9: the control is a filter with four states, not a continuous thing the hand drives; the memory sentence now has a verb (press SERVER) and the dim carries a fact, but on desktop the chosen lane leaves wide empty columns, and the moment is 300 ms of opacity. Original 8: the lanes come from this person's facts, and a swimlane record is still a known shape.
polish: Facts: kept the owner's Design System v2 lines; the care entry says 'being rebuilt' and 'no React screen is live yet'; Offday's server says 'Sign-in details sent by email'; the hero's second line is the owner's '5+ years. Part of two platform rewrites' with one link (bayyinahtv.com) instead of the derived since-years; the Bayyinah TV app entry says 'One web app, in both stores'; Sadaqah is active ('Built the payment and subscription screens …').

Gate: five type sizes on both first screens (13, 16, 28, 44, 66 and 13, 16, 22, 36, 38); the enlarge dialog locks the page (html overflow hidden while open, overscroll-behavior contain, scroll position kept, focus returns); every transition names its properties (no transition: all exists in the draft or the shared sheets); CLS 0.062 → 0.013 by measuring size-adjust on the claim string (72.5%, 103.6%, 116.3%) and matching the fallbacks' ascent and descent to the real faces.

Lead: the 2026 band is reordered: the care platform with its server first, then Design System v2, Bayyinah TV, Offday last. The first screen shows the care team calendar, the Bayyinah TV app and the care platform's server.

Hook: the lane headers are a radio group (Phone, Web, Server, All): the other lanes fade to 22%, the chosen lane's bars turn red, years without that lane fade, and the line under the claim becomes the lane's sentence with its entry count. Click, tap, arrow keys (instant, no travel), pressing the chosen lane again returns to All; reduced motion switches instantly; the facts are on the page before any input; on phones the other lanes are hidden so the stream shortens (10,790 px → 1,939 px for Server). The load-time bar animation is gone; the bars are static.

Clarity: entry and index links are underlined at rest (text-decoration, not a background line); plain index lines (no arm64, Farnsworth, dev/staging); the duplicated link row under the claim is gone (the record carries every link); the lane note is hidden on phones.

Phone: one paragraph per entry; the Offday phone screenshot dropped; the Incentiv screen shown only in the wide lanes; the index sits behind a disclosure (open on desktop, closed on phones); phone page 17,809 → 10,790 px; desktop 11,546 → 11,042 px.

Craft: entry names are h2 (no h1 → h3 jump); the claim has a bottom margin; the masthead has a fixed height; the All option sits at the row's end and never overlaps SERVER (its since-year hides under 1200 px). Not done in this pass: collapsing empty desktop lanes per year (it would break the shared year axis the control depends on).
skillNotes: Helped: the direction card forced rule, hook and delete test before code, and the 'finding the rule' steps (ten true facts, combine one with something the reader can see) produced the lanes from the role line 'since 2026 also the server'. first-screen.md's formula and word budget, the composition list and 'design the phone, do not shrink' were followed line by line. writing.md's translation table (component → building block, tenant → organization) matched what the checker later flagged. visual.md's starting-points table gave a non-reflex display face with a written reason, and its size-adjust fallback advice took CLS from 0.066 to 0.003. The meta-tag allow mechanism worked and shows as ○ in the report. The checker's density test (C08b/C08c) forced honest crops, and data-work on the crop box made the first-screen share accurate. In the polish pass, snippets/mechanism.md's table and radio-group pattern turned the reviewer's suggestion into a working control in one go, and font-loading.md's 'measure size-adjust on the claim string' was exactly the missing step: the generic 68% left a 0.21 shift, the measured 72.5% plus matched ascent/descent left 0.013. Unclear, wrong or missing: (1) visual.md's 'font-display: optional for the display face' is wrong for a lazy route on a cold load: the checker captured the fallback sans while reporting 'Big Shoulders Display' as the hero face, because it reads the computed family, not the rendered one; swap + preload + a size-adjusted local fallback is the working recipe (now in font-loading.md), and the checker should verify with document.fonts.check. (2) Hard rule 1 says work ≥ 25%/20%, but check.mjs fails only below 15%/12% and treats 25% as a soft signal; say which is the gate. (3) reference/checks.md does not exist although SKILL.md and the brief cite it, 'check.mjs --list' is not a flag (it tries to navigate to '--list'), and data/phrases.json, which the source says feeds T10–T10f, is missing, so the technical-word list C can only be learned by tripping it (it flags 'tiers', 'runtime', 'deep link', 'IVS', 'CSP'). (4) --facts CONTENT.md is accepted but no number check runs; the skill promises T45. (5) New ids appeared mid-round (C17, T10f, 'with canvas/video outside data-work') with no doc, as the brief warned. (6) C17 measures LCP across the checker's own scripted scroll, so a below-fold lazy image became 'largest paint at 4.1 s' on desktop while the t900 frame showed the first screen complete; freeze LCP at the first scroll or read the frames. (7) crop.md now gives the technique, but not the checker's own number: with a translated img the density test needs the crop to be ≥ 1.74× the box width (scale ≤ 0.575); put that number in the snippet. (8) first-screen.md's 'work starts above 500px' on a phone does not add up with its own element list; after removing the link row and putting the lane control in its place the work starts at about 465 px, so the fix was to delete an element the reference asks for. (9) C05b warns for short spaced links ('CV', 'Case') although the skill says spaced nav links may be smaller; 'CV' needs min-width, which only the new press-and-hover.css mentions. (10) The old press-and-hover.css drew underlines with background-image, and T12c read proof links styled that way as 'two boxed buttons under the hero'; the new snippet fixes this. (11) The hook ladder the reviewer proposes (7 plays once, 8 the visitor triggers a change, 9 a state driven continuously) was missing when the direction was chosen; directions.md's mechanisms table says 'a strong direction earns three, including M1 or M2' and this draft earned M1, M9, M13, M14 and scored 7 on hook; the ladder would have sent it to the lane control before the build. (12) C03 warns at six sizes while review.md fails the gate at six; the checker and the rubric disagree. (13) The checker has no dialog test; the reviewer found the scroll-through by hand. (14) C12 reports 'NAV #text #text' with no rects, so finding a shift means writing a PerformanceObserver script; print the source rects. (15) The draft-notes keys differ from the picker's DraftMeta type (fourAnswers, loopScores, pageLength, polish); harmless but undocumented.
